seed_offers.description: A flexible berry vine that can be sold raw or baked into Kelpberry Tart.
A spiced leaf crop for sharper daytime specials or a dependable cash fallback.

sell_entries.description: Move staple grain to nearby stalls for safe but modest cash.
Fresh herbs sell quickly, though the restaurant usually gets more from them.
Reliable berry cash flow when you need gold more than menu planning.
A good emergency sale, but flatbreads make better use of it.
A premium luminous fungus with a strong market price.
Recovered salvage can always be traded for upkeep money.
